meta.titre: Completing a sentence with a suitable word using context clues

sections.contenu_markdown: A missing word is never truly missing information: the rest of the sentence always leaves enough clues to find it.

items: Reading a full sentence before answering

sections.contenu_markdown: Read the whole sentence first, identify the topic or situation it describes, then choose the word that fits both the grammatical slot and the real-world meaning of the sentence.

sections.enonce_markdown: Complete: 'I take a good ... early in the morning' (meal context).

etapes.justification: The meal eaten early in the day.

sections.conclusion_markdown: I take a good breakfast early in the morning.

items.erreur_markdown: Answering with the first vocabulary word that comes to mind without checking it against the whole sentence.
items.pourquoi_faux: A word may be grammatically plausible but not fit the specific context described in the sentence.
items.correction_markdown: Always re-read the full completed sentence to check it makes real-world sense before finalising the answer.
